Rina (Product): Heads-up: customer 'Lucid' wants a firm p95 <= 120ms SLA for chat on their workload. They asked for a pilot in ~6 weeks. Need cross-team alignment — feasibility, cost, and rollback.

Theo (Eng-Runtime): Current numbers: p95 ~132ms on that model under mixed load. With route-level prefetch + tighter batching we can probably reach sub-120 but need pinned capacity. I can prototype batching changes.

Harper (Infra): Recommend dedicated reserved nodes (3 GPUs pinned) + KV prewarm. Provisioning 48-72h after approval. Will estimate cost for new vs. reuse. Isolation prefers new.

Zoe (Eng-Platform): Ill add a per-route toggle and console switch: prefetch=true, min_instances=3, fallback_variant=latency-opt. Will submit PR and add e2e smoke checks.

Ibrahim (Security): Security must get a dedicated KMS key, retention policy, and a PII-scan of inference traces before signoff. Ill draft the checklist.

Cory (PM): Lucid will cover reserved pool for pilot. Acceptance gates: 1) p95 <= 120ms on 10k real prompts; 2) error delta <= 0.1%; 3) signed KMS/retention; 4) tested fallback and rollback.

Rina (Product): Can each owner paste a one-line deliverable + ETA by EOD Thursday? Ill assemble a single pilot playbook and schedule a follow-up.

Theo (Eng-Runtime): Perf test plan + recommended batching config (ETA: Wed).

Harper (Infra): Cost + provisioning timeline (ETA: Wed afternoon).

Zoe (Eng-Platform): PR link + feature-flag (ETA: Thu morning).

Ibrahim (Security): KMS/retention checklist draft (ETA: Thu EOD).

Cory (PM): Ill collect Lucid prompts and acceptance window (ETA: Wed).

deploy-bot: Sync created: Pilot kickoff check-in Mon 10:00am PT. Invite sent.
